plain_language: An event (hit, turn start, ally hit, HP threshold) checks registered listeners
pseudocode: on(event): for effect in listeners[event.type]: if effect.condition(event): effect.execute(event)
engineering_note: Centralizes effects. Use priorities to stop infinite recursions.
game_examples: Last Cloudia; Honkai: Star Rail; Arknights

plain_language: If resources, cooldown, actor state and target are legal, charge cost and execute effects
pseudocode: if ready && canAct && targetValid && meter>=cost: spend(cost); run(ability.effects); cooldown.start()
engineering_note: Commit cost atomically only after validation.

plain_language: Store statuses per entity, each with duration, strength, category and source
pseudocode: Status(id,source,stacks,expiresAt,stackGroup,policy); onApply=>stackOrReplace(); onTick=>expire()
engineering_note: Stack policy can be ADDITIVE, UNIQUE, EXCLUSIVE, REFRESH, HIGHEST, INDEPENDENT.

plain_language: Start with base damage, apply weakness, crit, outgoing buffs, resistances, then shields
pseudocode: damage=calculateBase(); damage*=offense*weakness; damage=applyDefense(damage); absorbShields(); reduceHP(); deathHooks()
engineering_note: Specify game-specific order and stacking. Process post-hit hooks only if allowed.

plain_language: HP 0 may trigger next health bar, Guts, second phase or final attack
pseudocode: onLethal(): if hasGuts: revive(); elif nextPhase: transition(); elif finalMove: queueFinalMove(); else: die()
engineering_note: Do not despawn boss immediately when HP hits zero if final move is queued.

plain_language: Crossing a one-time HP percentage milestone emits a phase event
pseudocode: if oldHp>hpMax*t && newHp<=hpMax*t && !thresholdSeen[t]: emit(THRESHOLD,t); thresholdSeen[t]=true
engineering_note: Use crossing detection, not hpPct==value; never re-trigger on each hit.

plain_language: Boss opens a warning window; players can cancel by doing an objective
pseudocode: enterState(WINDUP); spawnTelegraph(); if cancelProgress>=required: cancel(); else after timer: execute()
engineering_note: State diagram: Idle→Windup→Cancelled OR Cast→Recovery.

plain_language: Qualifying hits deplete a secondary pool to open a vulnerability window
pseudocode: breakMeter-=attack.breakPower; if breakMeter<=0: state=BROKEN; applyWeakness(); after timer: recover()
engineering_note: Keep Break damage, HP damage and stagger duration separate.

plain_language: Turn-based actor acts when its initiative/AV is ready; buffs can advance
pseudocode: onTick(dt): actor.av-=speedScaled(dt); if actor.av<=0: actor.takeTurn(); actor.av=resetAV()
engineering_note: HSR uses Action Value; E7 uses Combat Readiness; do not reuse exact formulas.
game_examples: Honkai: Star Rail; Epic Seven; RAID

plain_language: Arts-gen buffs belong to named groups; groups may be exclusive
pseudocode: if newBuff.group==existing.group && groupIsExclusive: chooseEffectiveBuff(); else accumulateCompatibleBuffs()
engineering_note: Source-defined groups are authoritative; same-name and group relationships matter.

plain_language: Two matching cards combine to higher rank; play consumes action slots
pseudocode: onMerge(cardA,cardB): if sameType && adjacent && rankEqual: replaceWith(rank+1)
engineering_note: Merging can be strategic even if it spends action economy.

plain_language: Each side rolls skill power; winning side removes opposing coin until clash ends
pseudocode: while sideA.coins && sideB.coins: compare(rollA(),rollB()); loser.coins.pop()
engineering_note: Account for sanity and different attack coin rules.

plain_language: Incoming element interacts with existing aura to produce named reaction
pseudocode: reaction=reactionTable[aura][incomingElement]; if reaction: resolve(reaction, owner=incomingActor)
engineering_note: Triggering actor, gauge units, ICD and elemental ownership vary.

plain_language: Successful hit or team proc can enqueue a new action
pseudocode: onHit(event): if passiveEligible: actionQueue.push(newAction); consumeProcLimit()
engineering_note: Prevent never-ending counters with turn limits and recursion guards.
game_examples: Epic Seven; Honkai: Star Rail; PGR

plain_language: Periodic or event-driven status makes damage and may consume a counter
pseudocode: onStatusTrigger(target): target.hp-=status.potency; status.count-=1; if count==0: remove()
engineering_note: Different DoTs tick per turn, time, attack or hit.

plain_language: Persist hazardous coordinates independently of boss HP or actor statuses
pseudocode: tile.status=DANGER; onEnter(tile,actor): applyDebuff(); onBossCast: if tile.danger: executeExtraEffect()
engineering_note: Hazards may remain when boss moves, and can require operator redeployment.

plain_language: A boss presents destructible red target; destroying target cancels special
pseudocode: spawnPart(hp,timer); if part.hp<=0: cancelBossAttack(); if timer<=0: castBossAttack()
engineering_note: Separate boss body HP from interrupt target HP.

plain_language: Damage may consume hit-block stacks, absorb shield HP, or trigger invincibility
pseudocode: if hitBlock>0: hitBlock--; return; damage=shieldAbsorb(damage); if invincible: damage=0
engineering_note: Apply conditions and order explicitly.

plain_language: Apply chance, resistance and immunity, then register effect if allowed
pseudocode: if immune(status): return IMMUNE; chance=calcApplication(user,target); if roll()<chance: apply(status)
engineering_note: Guaranteed hits, immunities, debuff resistance down can override specific layers.
game_examples: Star Rail; Epic Seven; Last Cloudia

plain_language: Learning, obtaining, equipping and casting are separate states
pseudocode: unlocked=learnProgress>=need; learnedSkills.add(skill); if SC>=cost: equip(skill)
engineering_note: Do not confuse ark equipped passives with permanently learned ark skills.
